site/why-china.intro: China has become one of the world's leading destinations for international students - combining top universities, affordable costs, generous scholarships and real opportunity.

p: What makes it one of the smartest study-abroad decisions today.
ul: World-ranked universities: Study at Ministry of Education–listed and globally ranked institutions recognised worldwide.
English-taught degrees: Full degrees taught in English across medicine, engineering, business and more - no Chinese required to start.
Affordable & funded: Low tuition and living costs, plus generous government, provincial and university scholarships.
Opportunity & industry: Study in one of the world's largest economies, with real exposure to research and industry.
Rich culture & safety: Modern, safe cities with a deep culture and a large, welcoming international-student community.
Globally recognised degrees: Qualifications accepted by employers and licensing bodies around the world.

site/services.intro: From your first enquiry to your first day of class - and beyond - CAS supports you at every step of studying in China.

p: One team handling the whole journey, so nothing falls through the cracks.
ul: Admission service: We shortlist the right universities and programs, prepare your file and submit a complete, correct application on your behalf.
Visa assistance: Full support with your JW202, admission letter and student visa - with a track record of high approval rates.
Airport pickup: A CAS representative meets you on arrival and helps you get to campus safely and smoothly.
On-campus support: Ongoing help after you arrive - registration, accommodation, banking and day-to-day questions.
Scholarship assistance: We match you to government, provincial and university scholarships and help you apply on time.
Chinese language foundation: Guidance on HSK and foundation-year options so you're ready for study and life in China.

p: Trusted, transparent support at every step of your journey to China.
ul: Official authorized agency: Working directly with universities since 2012 - your application is in trusted, accountable hands.
Free to start, clear after: Your consultation and study plan are free; any service fees are quoted up front with no hidden charges.
One dedicated advisor: A single point of contact guides you from your first enquiry through to arrival.
Fast, complete applications: We prepare everything correctly the first time, so you don't lose an intake to resubmissions.
Strong admission record: A proven track record of getting students admitted and visa-ready.
Support after you arrive: Airport pickup, registration and settling-in help - we don't stop at the offer letter.

site/about.intro: CAS - Consultancy for Abroad Study - helps students from around the world study at Ministry of Education–listed universities across China. We handle the whole journey: choosing the right program, applying, securing scholarships, and supporting you through visa and arrival.

p: Three things we hold ourselves to with every student.
ul: Fees you can see before you pay: A free study plan, one application fee per student, and service charges that appear in your portal before you are asked to pay.
One place to follow your application: Your student portal shows every document, invoice and status update, so you always know the next step.
A real person, on your channel: Reach a CAS counselor on WhatsApp, WeChat, email or in the portal, in English.

p: A world-class education with real opportunity - at a fraction of the cost.
ul: World-ranked, Ministry of Education–listed universities
English-taught degrees across medicine, engineering and business
Affordable tuition and living costs with generous scholarships
A fast-growing hub for research, industry and opportunity

p: A clear, supported path from first enquiry to your first day of class.
ul: Choose: We match you to universities and programs that fit your goals, grades and budget.
Apply: We prepare your documents and submit a complete, correct application on your behalf.
Offer: Receive your admission offer and, where eligible, a scholarship.
Arrive: We guide you through the visa, travel and enrolment so you land ready to start.

p: CAS - to make studying abroad in China simple, transparent and successful for every student we work with.

p: Typical fees across the programs in our catalog, by level.

Taken from the tuition universities list for English-taught programs; the range covers the middle 80% of listed fees and the figure shown is the median. Accommodation, insurance and living costs are not included. Your university page shows the exact fee for each program.

ul: Accommodation: a university dormitory or private housing.
Medical insurance, required for international students.

Visa and residence permit, plus the physical examination.
Flights, and day-to-day living costs in your city.

p: Government and university scholarships can pay tuition, accommodation or a living stipend.
A study plan costs nothing. After that, a ¥1,000 application fee, plus document and service charges that depend on the university, program and degree.

ul: Initial consultation with an advisor
Personalised study plan
University and program shortlist
Scholarship matching guidance
Application handling: Document review and submission to your chosen universities.
Visa support: Help with the admission letter, JW202 form and visa application.
Accommodation booking: A place arranged before you arrive.
Airport pickup and arrival support: Someone to meet you and help you settle in.
Certified translation: Translation of transcripts, diplomas and certificates.
p: Your advisor sends the exact document and service charges in writing before you commit. You only pay for the services you accept.

ul: Get your free plan: Tell us your grades, budget and goals. We send a shortlist and a scholarship check at no charge.
Receive an itemised quote: If you want help beyond the plan, we list each service and its price in writing.
Pick what you need: Accept the whole package or only some services. Nothing is added without your agreement.

site/partner.intro: Place your students in Chinese universities through an authorized agency. Submit and track applications in one portal and see where each commission stands.

p: The tools and support a recruiting agency needs, in one place.
ul: One channel to many universities: Apply to Ministry of Education-listed universities across China without managing each university separately.
A live partner portal: Add students, submit applications and watch each status change as it happens.
Commission you can follow: Every placement shows its commission stage in your portal, from expected to paid.
Up-to-date information: Program lists, fees and application windows you can use when you counsel students.

p: Everything you do with CAS happens in one account.
ul: Manage students: Add each student once and keep their details and documents together.
Apply to universities: Choose programs and submit applications, or apply for scholarships, from one wizard.
Track every application: See each application's current status and what is needed next.
See your commissions: Check which commissions are expected, eligible, invoiced and paid.

p: Each placement moves through the same stages, and you can see the current one.
ul: Expected: The student has applied and a commission is recorded.
Pending arrival: The student is admitted and we wait for them to arrive.
Eligible: The student has arrived, registered and paid the first-year fee.
Invoiced: CAS invoices the university for the commission.
Paid to you: Once received, your share is payable and then paid.
Apply to partner: Create a partner account with your agency details.
Get approved: Our team reviews your application and activates your portal access.
Refer and track: Add students, submit applications and follow them to arrival.
p: Commission becomes eligible only after the student's arrival, registration and first-year fee payment. Rates depend on the university and are confirmed to you when you join.

ul: Study-abroad agencies and education consultants.
Schools and colleges that place graduates abroad.
Individual recruiters who counsel students regularly.
Teams who want one place to run applications to China.
